claims.atomic_claim: GitHub Release Asset API digest fields are present for Nightfall release assets.
claims.limitation: GitHub API asset digests are integrity metadata, not source-to-binary proof.

claims.atomic_claim: The local GitHub CLI supports attestation verification.
claims.limitation: CLI support does not mean release assets have attestations.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall binary-like release assets have verifiable GitHub build attestations.
claims.limitation: Attestation verification must still be linked to expected commit, workflow and builder identity.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall release assets are fully linked to specific workflow runs.
claims.limitation: Requires workflow-run linkage analysis in v0.8.
Requires stronger provenance and/or reproducible build comparison.
Binary safety cannot be inferred from metadata or attestations alone.
